title: Check each draft
intro: You will see single drafts made for your own messages, one at a time, in a mixed order. For each one, say what it says and whether you would accept it.
Some drafts are close to what you meant and some are not. If you answer No, write in the note box what is wrong.

help.text: One draft at a time, with the keywords it was made from, the sentence you meant and your other version.
What I meant: it carries the message you meant. My other version: it carries the message of your other sentence. Something else: neither.
Yes as it is, yes with a small edit (a word or two), or no. If no, write in the note box what is wrong.

acc.title: Would you accept it as your message?
acc.text: If you answer No, write in the note box what is wrong (a few words).

ver.title: What does this draft say?
ver.text: Compare it with what you meant and with your other version.
